head_commit.message: Nicer highlighting of slash commands, /plan accepts prompt args and pasted images (#10269) ## Summary - Make typed slash commands become text elements when the user hits space, including paste‑burst spaces. - Enable `/plan` to accept inline args and submit them in plan mode, mirroring `/review` behavior and blocking submission while a task is running. - Preserve text elements/attachments for slash commands that take args. ## Changes - Add safe helper to insert element ranges in the textarea. - Extend command‑with‑args pipeline to carry text elements and reuse submission prep. - Update `/plan` dispatch to switch to plan mode then submit prompt + elements. - Document new composer behavior and add tests. ## Notes - `/plan` is blocked during active tasks (same as `/review`). - Slash‑command elementization recognizes built‑ins and `/prompts:` custom commands only. ## Codex author `codex fork 019c16d3-4520-7bb0-9b9d-48720d40a8ab`

head_commit.message: Nicer highlighting of slash commands, /plan accepts prompt args and pasted images (#10269) ## Summary - Make typed slash commands become text elements when the user hits space, including paste‑burst spaces. - Enable `/plan` to accept inline args and submit them in plan mode, mirroring `/review` behavior and blocking submission while a task is running. - Preserve text elements/attachments for slash commands that take args. ## Changes - Add safe helper to insert element ranges in the textarea. - Extend command‑with‑args pipeline to carry text elements and reuse submission prep. - Update `/plan` dispatch to switch to plan mode then submit prompt + elements. - Document new composer behavior and add tests. ## Notes - `/plan` is blocked during active tasks (same as `/review`). - Slash‑command elementization recognizes built‑ins and `/prompts:` custom commands only. ## Codex author `codex fork 019c16d3-4520-7bb0-9b9d-48720d40a8ab`
